body: Remove the ENABLE_LLM_ANALYSIS=true requirement. Processor now defaults to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is present, stub otherwise. All 5316 existing stub signals will be superseded as the processor re-analyzes new filings with real classification.
title: S36-04: processor now uses haiku when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set — no ENABLE_LLM_ANALYSIS gate
